findings.title: ResourcesScreen does not handle empty courseId — sends bad API request
findings.description: The design claims ResourcesScreen handles an empty courseId by showing all resources. In reality, offlineResourcesProvider passes courseId directly to the API with no empty-string guard, sending GET /resources?courseId= to the backend. No 'show all' branch exists in the screen or provider.
findings.fix: Add a guard in offlineResourcesProvider: omit the courseId query param when it is empty, or document and verify that the backend returns all resources for an absent/empty courseId.

findings.title: _QuickAction widget is not grid-compatible without layout changes
findings.description: The design claims the _QuickAction widget is unchanged and only the container changes. The widget uses Column(mainAxisSize: min) and TextOverflow.visible. In a GridView.count cell this produces top-aligned content and text that can bleed outside cell boundaries. The design omits the required Center wrapper and overflow fix.
findings.fix: Wrap _QuickAction (or create a _QuickActionCell variant) with Center and change overflow to TextOverflow.ellipsis for use inside GridView cells. The design must specify this change explicitly.

findings.title: flutter clean does not fix a pub solver failure; runbook explanation is incorrect
findings.description: The user's error showed flutter pub get failing (a pub solver error). The design explains this as a 'stale cached APK' and prescribes flutter clean. flutter clean does not affect pub's package cache (~/.pub-cache/). If pubspec.yaml already has ^8.3.7, the pub solver should not fail at all, so the design's explanation contradicts itself.
findings.fix: Add to the runbook: if flutter pub get still fails, run 'flutter pub cache repair' or delete pubspec.lock and re-run 'flutter pub get'. Correct the explanation to distinguish pub solver failures from Gradle/AAR failures.

findings.title: GoRoute insertion point is ambiguous relative to parameterised routes
findings.description: The design says to add new routes 'after GoRoute(path: AppRoutes.connections, ...)' but does not specify whether they go before or after the two parameterised routes (/:threadId and /:userId) that follow connections in the source.
findings.fix: State explicitly: insert the three new GoRoute entries after AppRoutes.connections and before the /:threadId and /:userId parameterised routes. Or provide the complete updated routes list.

findings.title: childAspectRatio 0.85 is contingent on a layout fix that the design omits
findings.description: The childAspectRatio calculation assumes correct vertical centring of content in grid cells. Without the Center wrapper fix (Finding 2), the ratio is irrelevant because content will be top-aligned regardless. The design presents the ratio as independently valid.
findings.fix: Add a note that childAspectRatio: 0.85 is only correct when cells are wrapped with Center to handle vertical alignment. The ratio should be re-verified after the layout fix is applied.

findings.title: Placeholder screens use ConsumerWidget with an unused ref parameter
findings.description: The placeholder screens extend ConsumerWidget but never use ref. flutter analyze will emit an unused-parameter warning, which the design's own rationale (Riverpod-aware for future use) does not justify over a plain StatelessWidget.
findings.fix: Use StatelessWidget for the placeholders now and migrate to ConsumerWidget when ref is actually needed, or add a comment acknowledging the unused parameter is intentional.

findings.title: flutter run --debug flag is redundant
findings.description: flutter run already defaults to debug mode. The --debug flag adds noise without meaning.
findings.fix: Replace 'flutter run --debug' with 'flutter run' in the runbook.
